title: Orchestration workflows are reusable named presets
description:
As an operator, I want orchestration workflows to be committed named presets, so that production agent runs do not depend on temporary per-run workflow files.

Feature: Named orchestration workflows

Scenario: Worker resolves a named workflow from project workflows
Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
And a local orchestration target repository
And a project orchestration workflow "call-criteria/poetry-upgrade"
When I run "kanbus worker run kanbus-run01 --workflow call-criteria/poetry-upgrade --target-repo target"
Then the named workflow should be resolved from project/workflows

Scenario: Missing named workflow fails clearly
Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
When I run "kanbus worker run kanbus-run01 --workflow missing/workflow --target-repo target"
Then the command should fail with exit code 1
And stderr should contain "workflow preset not found"
